C9000374.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 374 (Sharp one-third stability of Brenier maps.; papers: Sharp One-Third Stability of Brenier Maps; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/374.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C374_MECHANISM.statement: Verify the literal moment-to-potential mechanism, strengthened to sharp moment constant 1 and finite-potential constant 2R.

C374_DERIVATIVE.statement: Every intercept direction satisfies the stationary-site derivative estimate with coefficient 1, uniformly over positive masses and distinct sites.

C374_SECANT.statement: Two positive-mass fixed-site affine partitions satisfy the sharp finite mass-to-moment contraction with arithmetic-mean mass denominators.

C374_MIDPOINT.statement: Uniform laws on positive-volume compact convex sets admit a coupling whose midpoint density is at most the reciprocal geometric mean of their volumes; corresponding cell midpoints lie in disjoint midpoint cells.

C374_CALCULUS.statement: Cell masses and moments are jointly C1 on the distinct-site positive-mass locus, with symmetric face derivatives, a connected face graph, zero-sum Laplacian range, and C1 normalized prescribed-mass intercepts.

C374_CORE.statement: Finite-dimensional midpoint quadratic energy implies sharp moment contraction; symmetric face operators satisfy duality, which transfers the moment bound to intercept-speed energy when the weighted mass equation has a qualitative solution witness.

C374_SHARPNESS.statement: Positive rational two-cell boxes in every dimension at least two attain normalized derivative-energy ratios tending to 1.

C374_POTENTIAL.statement: Every finite pair of target probabilities has convex affine-max transport potentials at L2 distance at most 2R W2, without a quantitative inverse-Laplacian constant.
